blocks.en: It is clear that $\mathcal{D}(A^\times)$ is nonempty since $\{0\}\in\mathcal{D}(A^\times)$. Also, it follows directly from the definition that $A^\times$ is linear. Furthermore, for bounded operators we can show the following.
blocks.zh: 显然 $\mathcal{D}(A^\times)$ 非空, 因为 $\{0\}\in\mathcal{D}(A^\times)$. 而且由定义直接可知 $A^\times$ 为线性算子. 此外, 对有界算子可证明以下结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: For any bounded operator $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ we have $\mathcal{D}(A^\times)=Y^*$ and $A^\times:Y^*\to X^*$ is a bounded operator with $\|A^\times\|=\|A\|$.
blocks.zh: 对于任意有界算子 $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$, 有 $\mathcal{D}(A^\times)=Y^*$, 且 $A^\times:Y^*\to X^*$ 是有界算子, 满足 $\|A^\times\|=\|A\|$.
